title: $K$-Theoretic Comparison of Roe and Quasi-Local Algebras via Projections
summary: A central question in higher index theory and operator algebras is whether the Roe algebra and the quasi-local algebra associated with a metric space of bounded geometry coincide, or at least have the same $K$-theory. In this paper, we focus on a \emph{sparse} metric space $X$. We prove the following three main results: (1) For a block-diagonal operator $T$ with uniformly bounded block-rank, $T$ is quasi-local if and only if it is in the Roe algebra.
